aboutus.title: About Us
aboutus.paragraph1: Albeit in its youth our small numbered community only had a dream, in 2025 it officially became The Ciculi József Organization. Its dream was simple: to establish a home in the hearts of the people, which could be protected by Ciculi József. The pillars of this home being trust, solidarity and last but not least, entertainment.
aboutus.paragraph2: It is by virtue of Ciculi Jozsef, whom, seen at first sight in 2023 gave our president, Mihály Dávid-Zsolt, the necessary inspiration to build our community, making all of this possible. Yet in the minds of those who have just discovered us lingers the question: "Who is Ciculi József?". Although the pictures on our website do not do justice to the splendidness of our honorary president, they at least illustrate his appearance. The svelte orange cat, with its mysterious yet alluring personality became the perfect representative of our organization,  Ciculi József being at its core the symbol of our community's solidarity.
aboutus.paragraph3: When it comes to the future our organization is looking forward to further develop our Cluj-Napoca branch, as there is a significant number of members that currently reside there.
